CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(UnitCost), UnitCost = 0, ISBLANK(ListPrice), ListPrice = 0 ), "Margin is not available", TEXT( ROUND( ((UnitCost - ListPrice) / UnitCost) * 100, 2 ) ) & "%" )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Margin % = (Unit Price - Unit Cost) / Unit Price.
CustomField.label: Margin Percentage
